headline: Barcelona thrashes Guangzhou Evergrande
content: Injuries aside, were still aiming high, says Lionel Messi after Barcelonas convincing win over China’s Guangzhou Evergrande during their semi-final match in Yokohama, Japan. Despite missing key players like Messi himself who suffered kidney issues, and Neymar dealing with muscle injuries, the team advanced to face Argentine side River Plate in Sundays finals. Coach Luis Enrique remains uncertain whether these stars would return for the decisive game.

headline: Jose Mourinho leaves Chelsea
content: After three successful seasons winning the English Premiership League titles in 2005, 2006, and 2015, Jose Mourinho parted ways with Chelsea citing mutual agreement following disappointing results throughout the season which saw the Blues languishing in sixteenth place.

headline: Valentina Shevchenko makes her debut in UFC
content: Born in Kyrgyzstan but naturalized Peruvian, Valentina Shevchenko prepares to make her mark against Canadian fighter Sara Kaufmann in the upcoming fight night event held in Orlando, USA. With extensive experience across various martial arts disciplines including Muay Thai, Kickboxing, and K-1, she aims to showcase her skills honed over more than twenty years.

headline: Ian Gubbins wins Billabong Punta Blanca Surf Championship
content: Surfers gathered yesterday in Piura where Ian Gubbins clinched victory at the thirteenth edition of the highly anticipated surf competition, Billabong Punta Blanca. His performance stood out amidst excellent wave conditions along Punta Blancas famed left break.

headline: How to combine foods to avoid weight gain during festivities?
content: Maintaining our weight despite numerous celebrations requires not just moderation but also understanding food combinations for proper digestion. This involves prioritizing whole, minimally processed foods while balancing carbohydrates, proteins, fats, fruits, vegetables, and avoiding refined sugars to prevent digestive discomfort and unwanted calorie intake.

headline: Carlos E. Paredes presents book analysis
content: Renowned economist Carlos E. Paredes offers insights into Perus economy transitioning from prosperity to recession in his latest publication titled ‘From Prosperity to Economic Decline’ – What Do We Do Next?

headline: Star Wars fever hits Coliseum Diaz
content: Fans gather today at Coliseum Diaz for Star Con 2015, celebrating everything related to the iconic franchise. Activities include costume contests, workshops, panels featuring experts discussing elements of the series, alongside showcasing fan-made artworks inspired by the universe created by George Lucas.

headline: Independent Design Fair opens at Park Family
content: Starting December 19 till January 3rd, independent designers exhibit clothing brands such as Faite, Amapolas, Flamas among others within Barrancos Park Family venue offering fashion showcases, music performances, and interactive activities aimed towards promoting local creativity.
